text:
Miranda: Heads up — noticed a weird billing blip tied to client backpressure + sidecar GC this morning. Saw a handful of requests that got charged twice after a short reconnect.
Sanjay: Can you paste the raw logs? sounds like a session id regen or router reassign.
Miranda: pasted snippet: ```INFO 2024-05-03 stream: recv eof after chunk=12 session=abc123 sidecar=pod-7 "gc" triggered ttl=30s
DEBUG ledger: provisional_credit(session=abc123, tokens=42) -> apply confirmed at ack=15
WARN router: session not found, fallback to new-session -> reroute to pool-b
```
Jamie: ugh. So sidecar GC removed the provisional ledger row before the provisional->confirmed transition could be reconciled?
Priya: That would explain duplicate charges — client retries, router creates a fresh session, same toolcall gets applied again. Did the client include idempotency keys?
Miranda: Some of these were streaming toolcalls (chunked), client didn't have explicit idempotency for mid-stream reconnections. The router uses session affinity + provisional ledger entries keyed by session id. When GC removed the row, we lost the claim.
Sanjay: We have two failure modes: 1) GC TTL too aggressive for extreme backpressure/retry windows; 2) when sidecar is recreated with a new session id the router can't attach to old provisional and issues a new toolcall. Both cause double-counting.
Jamie: For immediate mitigation: increase sidecar GC TTL for sessions flagged as "active_stream" or add a short resurrection window on the ledger (mark tombstone for 60s instead of hard delete). Thoughts?
Priya: ✅ Add a tombstone with metadata: original_session_id, provisional_tokens. That lets router detect reattach and drain provisional rather than reapply. It'll need console visualization so ops can see provisional vs confirmed credits.
Miranda: Agree. Also we should audit the console's per-route dashboard — the provisional token column is currently missing for streaming routes. Hard to triage without it.
ops-bot: deploy-preview: sidecar-gc-tombstone-proposal -> branch:fix/gc-tombstone deployed to staging (run id: 2024-05-03-09) :rocket:
Sanjay: Implementation concerns: tombstone increases storage churn. We should add compaction via a TTL label only after confirm window. Also instrument metric `sidecar.tombstone.hit` and `router.reattach.success`.
Jamie: UX ask: when rollouts are gated for this change, show a per-customer provisional/confirmed token delta in the console so SREs can quickly identify customers hit by GC churn. Maybe a sparkline of provisional spikes.
Priya: For telemetry, propose a new trace attribute `session_recreate_reason` on router spans. Values: `gc_deleted`, `client_reconnect`, `region_failover`. That will let us filter traces causing duplicate charging.
Miranda: Action items:
- S: land tombstone PR + add metrics (sidecar.tombstone.*)
- J: console mock for provisional/confirmed column + rollout gating flag
- P: tracing attr + add alert rule if provisional/confirmed delta > 10% in 5m
- M: run a staging soak with intermittent client backpressure generator for 24h

Sanjay: I'll take the PR. Miranda can you drop the failing trace logs into the GH issue?
Miranda: done, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/1429
Jamie: thanks — we'll coordinate rollout with a bake window and feature flag. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll add the alert and a dashboard panel.
Miranda: closing the loop here — thanks all.
